title: VP of Operations & Supply Chain
text:
**Position Overview**

The Vice President of Operations & Supply Chain serves as an executive operational leader responsible for driving domestic manufacturing performance while scaling global strategic sourcing. Headquartered on-site at our metal fabrication and assembly facility, this role oversees domestic plant operations and integrates supply chain operations within a focused portfolio of key international suppliers. This leader will balance hands-on, plant-level operational leadership with high-level international sourcing strategy to support business growth.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Domestic Manufacturing & Plant Operations**

· Lead all daily plant operations across metal fabrication, assembly, quality control, safety, and inventory management.

· Drive continuous improvement (Lean / Six Sigma) to optimize throughput, reduce scrap rates, and manage labor efficiency.

· Foster a high-accountability safety culture adhering to OSHA standards.

· Maintain direct, visible leadership on the shop floor to build strong relationships with operational teams.

· Establish clear key performance indicators (KPIs) for manufacturing efficiency, operational costs, equipment utilization, and schedule adherence.

· Oversee capital expenditure (CapEx) planning, facility maintenance, and automation/equipment upgrades to optimize plant capacity and throughput.

**2. Global Supply Chain, Strategic Sourcing & Post-Acquisition Integration**

· Partner with executive business leaders to architect and execute a unified global supply chain strategy leveraging domestic fabrication alongside overseas contract manufacturing partners.

· Align and execute global supply chain initiatives to support these activities, blending distinct business models (domestic fabrication vs. Asian contract manufacturing).

· Establish vendor management systems, quality standards, and logistics frameworks for international contract manufacturers.

· Develop processes to manage import/export compliance, international logistics, tariffs, and total landed cost models.

· Evaluate and optimize global supplier networks to build resilience, optimize costs, and drive margin performance.

· Establish end-to-end supply chain visibility and inventory positioning strategies across domestic warehouses and overseas vendor pipelines

**3. Industry Alignment & Custom Project Delivery**

· Align manufacturing capacity and scheduling with the fast-paced, custom-project demand cycles typical of the hospitality furnishings/fixtures market.

· Partner with Sales, Engineering, and Project Management to deliver custom fabricated assemblies on time and within budget.

**4. Executive Leadership & Culture**

· Serve as a core member of the operational leadership team, aligning operational goals with company-wide profitability and growth targets.

· Lead with a general management orientation—translating financial targets into shop-floor operational realities.

· Thrive as a key community and company leader in a small-town operational setting.

**Candidate Qualifications**

· **Experience:** 15+ years of progressive leadership in manufacturing operations and supply chain management.

· **Industry Background:** Proven background in metal fabrication, welding, stamping, and assembly—ideally serving the hospitality, commercial interiors, or custom project-based industries.

· **Global Experience:** Demonstrated experience with international sourcing, managing Asian contract manufacturers, and post-merger supply chain integration.

· **Company Size Fit:** Experience operating in mid-market environment ($50M–$150M revenue) with 200+ employees; comfortable wearing multiple hats without heavy administrative infrastructure.

· **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in operations management and/or Supply Chain Management (Master’s / MBA preferred).

**Key Attributes & Fit Factors**

· **Dual-Oriented Leadership:** Ability to walk the factory floor in work boots in the morning and lead strategic global supplier negotiations in the afternoon.

· **Cultural & Community Fit:** Comfortable living and leading in a small-town environment while maintaining a broad, global perspective.

· **Change Management:** Skilled in bridging two distinct operational cultures—domestic manufacturing and international third-party sourcing.

Pay: $76,800.00 - $92,600.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Disability insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person
